resources.string: Capture a thought by typing or speaking, or open your planner.
Shows your current task around the front camera.

RPM Notch draws a small black pill around the front camera with your current or next task from your RPM plan, and water reminders when you track water. Tap it to see the next few items and to tick the task, capture a thought or log a meal in RPM. Android only lets apps draw there through an accessibility service. RPM Notch does not read the screen, your typing or other apps, and it sends nothing anywhere. It hides on the lock screen and in landscape. Turn it off here at any time.
